verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl, one of 5 that year.

notes.text: This version has a 2-lined rim text on both sides as opposed to
that has a 2-lined rim text on side A label and a 3-lined rim text on side B label and

that has 3 lines on both labels.

Manufactured in Germany, intended for distribution all over the European market.

Copies distributed in Germany with green/black sticker "RTL Plus  Die Musik zur RTL-Serie  Start: 10.9.91  7599-26316-1"
Title on labels: "Soundtrack From Twin Peaks"

Some or all copies sold in Germany came with a pink 12 x 12 cm fold-out booklet advertising merchandise.
